study.question: Does the empirical distribution of sustained short-gap run lengths retain useful higher-order temporal information beyond the incumbent event, gap/recency and symmetric adjacent-gap summaries, with exactly the same visible history and training recipe?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation from source plus an explicit aliasing witness: the incumbent is invariant to histories with short-gap run lengths (1,1,4) versus (1,2,3) when short gaps are 10 seconds, separators 100 seconds, all identities/actions are equal, all nine ages occupy one log2 and coarse-age bin, and the directed gap-pair tables agree. The new readout separates these histories. Empirical run-length histograms may predict activity persistence beyond the number of runs R and total short gaps S. Local performance motivates examining time, but does not establish this mechanism: g1-r0017-gap_product AUC 0.630001910 versus g1-r0017-independent_product 0.629978563 is nearly null for their association contrast; g1-r0022-timing_joint 0.630685356 versus timing_marginal 0.630490923 gives preliminary support for another timing association. g1-r0023-serial_symmetric 0.630775887 exceeds serial_marginal 0.630653842 and serial_zero 0.630275728, but serial_observed 0.630472194 is lower than all except zero. Thus serial direction is unsupported and symmetrization may regularize. Symmetric serial Logloss 0.192852818 is worse than zero 0.192682677, so the primary AUC improvement is not a calibration improvement. All are validation selections at one seed, with adaptive selection bias and no significance claim.

Entire serial_symmetric model including embeddings, match-group means/count histograms, factorized moments, pooled field energy, identity/context/repetition/overlap readouts, chronological product transitions, direct lifted pooled gap and joint gap/recency branches; no head removed or reinitialized relative to scratch construction.
Exact parent parameter initialization and allocation order before appending the new branch; fixed Adam/lr=0.001, hidden [128,64], embedding_dim 16, host 3 epochs/batch4096; no optimizer/loss changes.

Complete-category/brand singleton timestamp subsequence, oldest first; exclude every tied member and bridge excluded events exactly as ancestor. Adjacency is over supported observations, not a raw-event or uncensored-session claim.
Inherited gap thresholds (0,60], (60,3600], (3600,86400], >86400 seconds; positive identity magnitude, action and target do not enter the new temporal branch.
study.proposed_difference: For thresholds 60,3600,86400 seconds, count each maximal nonempty run of consecutive short gaps, including observed-window boundary runs. A run of k gaps spans k+1 supported events. Keep exact per-length histograms internally; bin lengths as 1,2,3-4,5-8,9-16,17-32,33-64,65+, then log1p/log129 and concatenate 3x8=24 coordinates into a bias-free 24->16->1 ReLU residual whose final weights start at zero. Observed arm uses empirical lengths. Composition control replaces them per impression/threshold by the expected histogram under a uniform positive composition of S short gaps into R runs: E[N_k]=R*C(S-k-1,R-2)/C(S-1,R-1) for R>=2, deterministic k=S for R=1, zero for R=0. The replacement preserves R,S and short-short count S-R mathematically; these are recoverable from the inherited gap and symmetric serial tables. It is computed by a stable nonnegative cumprod recurrence, with no fitted statistics. Replacements at three thresholds need not jointly realize a history. Zero arm receives zeros with identical allocation and table computation. O(BL log L) support sorting and O(B*3*L) new work/storage, no training L-squared tensor. All three standalone modules have identical Model ASTs; only literal/registered run_mode differs. No broad novelty assertion: registry paper searches burst, sequence, session and run-length had no hits, so coverage of session/run-length literature remains incomplete.
predictions: Implementation prediction: scalar oracle error, run-count and short-gap conservation error, reorder/padding/positive-ID/target-action invariance errors and whole-parent witness logit error should be zero up to floating rounding. Expected count/mass errors should be <=1e-3 on the host float32 first512 diagnostic scope. Oracle uses only first8 rows and no labels. Any larger error blocks scientific interpretation until diagnosed within remaining budget.

Information prediction: witness directed serial table, run count R, short-gap mass S, expected histogram and whole parent logits agree; observed run histogram and 24-coordinate features differ. Selected composition and zero residuals cannot distinguish it; observed head may learn a distinction, but witness sensitivity alone is not utility evidence.

Primary predictive contrast: run_observed should exceed run_composition on full-population validation ROC-AUC at matched passes/seed if higher-order run information is useful. run_composition vs run_zero estimates value of an extra nonlinear readout of already recoverable summaries. run_observed vs run_zero estimates net branch value. Report Logloss separately and retain any disagreement.

Predeclared descriptive slices use host history-length bins with supplied sample/positive/negative counts. Added temporal discrimination is expected mostly in long-history slices; no utility is guaranteed for empty or short histories. Joint retraining can change logits even where new branch features vanish. Do not claim conditional/slice significance without user-cluster uncertainty or repeated paired results.

All variants allocate 400 extra dense parameters (expected total 17254067, embedding 17078688, dense 175379; host verifies) and execute the same new counts, expected distribution and binnings. Measure wall/GPU time, memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. A training-pass win alone does not demonstrate an equal-compute improvement; report measured quality-cost frontier rather than assuming equal cost.
falsifiers: If run_observed fails to exceed run_composition at matched passes or reverses across paired seeds, higher-order run utility lacks support under this implementation. A failure is not a general refutation of session/run-length modeling.

If composition matches observed while both exceed zero, improvement is explained by readout/optimization of R,S or other redundant information, without evidence for empirical higher-order lengths. If zero is best, retain the incumbent and stop this run-length direction unless an explicit diagnostic justifies a different admissible test.

If witness whole-parent outputs or serial counts differ, or conservation/oracle/invariance checks fail beyond tolerance, the intended mechanism contrast has not been implemented and measured scores cannot support it.

If modest AUC gain costs enough additional time/latency to be dominated on the measured quality-cost frontier, no efficiency claim is warranted. Loss degradation remains a negative finding even if AUC improves.
One adaptively selected seed, first512 diagnostics, or independent mechanism witnesses cannot establish a repeated predictive mechanism. Missing external literature detail keeps priority unverified.
alternative_explanations: Uniform-composition and empirical histograms have different variance, sparsity, post-log norms and implicit regularization even with identical R,S; matched allocated capacity is not matched effective capacity or optimization geometry. Norm diagnostics expose rather than remove this confound.

R,S may be easier for an extra head to decode than from inherited tables; composition vs zero addresses this. The positive observed-vs-composition contrast would be consistent with useful extra information but not isolate every representational/optimization cause.

Long histories, temporal population drift, recent-activity intensity, supported-subsequence filtering and truncation may explain apparent burst utility. Window-boundary runs are censored observations, not verified real user sessions.

Filtering drops missing fields and all timestamp ties, and may bridge real events; no claim transfers to tied/raw/full history or longer than128 inputs. Prior packet/singleton results g1-r0021-packet_observed 0.630425397 vs singleton_observed 0.630272924 were small and do not establish that broader support is better.

Prior abandoned branches were unhelpful: g1-r0000-behavior_within 0.611912887 below baseline-din 0.613361986; g1-r0011-event_energy 0.619704929 below its 0.620093787 parent; directed serial below symmetric/marginal. All exposed trajectory statuses are success and previous_runtime_error is null: these are scientific negative/null branches, not execution failures. No inaccessible failures are fabricated.

Adaptive validation selection across many trajectories and seed-specific joint-training variation can explain small gains. Three paired seeds and user-cluster bootstrap are desired only through authorized host feedback; no test/holdout input is used.
